bias.en: Downtrend · broke $101.8, lowest close since January
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $101.8，收盘创 1月以来新低

read.en: Corning fell 10.9% on Nov 20 to $94.38, its lowest close since Jan 23, trading $93.49–103.88 on heavy volume (1.53x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($104.6), 10-day ($110.5), 30-day ($122.5), 100-day ($147.5) and 200-day ($156.5), all falling. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 19, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR turned bearish on Nov 20 ($123.87), and RSI is 30.5.
read.zh: 康宁 11月20日下跌 10.9%，收于 $94.38，为 1月23日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $93.49–103.88，成交放量（为 20 日均量的 1.53 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$104.6）、10 日（$110.5）、30 日（$122.5）、100 日（$147.5）和 200 日均线（$156.5）下方，均在下行。MACD 自 11月19日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 于 11月20日转为看空（$123.87），RSI 为 30.5。

read.en: The drop broke both written supports, $101.8–104.4 (Nov 5, 6 and 17 lows), now resistance. Resistance is $95–96.6 (Jan 15 and Dec 11 highs), then $101.8–104.6 (Nov 20 high, 5-day) and $106–108.2. Support is $91–93.6 (Nov 20 and Jan 23 lows), then $90–90.6 and $84.6–84.8 (December 2025 low). A close above $96.6 would target $101.8–104.6; below $90, $84.6–84.8.
